blocking_findings.location: PDF image 81 (printed p.73), footnote 96, marker after the priestly-blessing introduction ending 'כָּאָמוּר:'
blocking_findings.issue: The note that labels the missing later source is out of date and contradicts the pages before it. It says the transcription covers Zikhronot and the opening of Shofarot (אתה נגלית), and that 'המשך שופרות והמשך התפילה טרם נכללו' (the rest of Shofarot and of the service is not yet included). But pages 78–80 contain the full Shofarot section: verses, Hallelujah, 'כן תגן', אלהינו ואלהי אבותינו תקע, the shofar-blowing instruction, היום הרת עולם, ארשת, רצה, and modim/priestly-blessing introduction. So the missing-source label is not accurate. It should say that the batch ends at the priestly-blessing introduction and that the actual verses (source 312 onward) are not yet included. The mixed Hebrew/Latin page reference in the note also renders with scrambled bidi order ('PDF292–293 (136;'), so it is hard to read.
blocking_findings.fix: Rewrite the note text to describe the real stopping point (after the priestly-blessing introduction, before the source-312 verses). Wrap the page/PDF reference in an LTR isolate (or put it in Hebrew order) so it displays correctly.

blocking_findings.issue: Words run together where a bold instruction label meets the text that follows: 'השליח ציבור מסייםבָּרוּךְ' (no space between label and בָּרוּךְ) and 'השליח ציבור בקולכֹּהֲנִים' (בקול fused to כֹּהֲנִים). These are visible text defects in the final export.
blocking_findings.fix: Add the missing whitespace at the boundary between the label/instruction element and the text in the export transform.

nonblocking_findings.issue: Line spacing in the paired verse rows is uneven. Most rows are widely spaced, but two-line paragraphs (e.g. 'הַלְלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ…', 'הַלְלוּהוּ בִּגְבוּרֹתָיו…') are set tight. This looks like the result of the deliberate stylesheet choice, so it is cosmetic only.

verdict: Not approved. On all five PDF pages there is no clipping or overlap of text, and the Hebrew pointing (vowels, CGJ and mappiq) is readable. Source-link arrows (↗) are present, running prose and stanza rows render as the stylesheet intends, and the Sources/credits/license section and archive.org links are kept on PDF image 82. The HTML screenshots at 1280 and 390 show no horizontal overflow (manifest scrollWidth equals width, no broken links or duplicate IDs) and match the PDF content order. These pages are Hebrew-only, so there were no English columns to check. Approval is blocked by two things: (B1) the missing-source note 96 is out of date, still saying the rest of Shofarot is not included when it plainly is, so the end of the batch is mislabelled; and (B2) words are fused at label boundaries ('מסייםברוך', 'בקולכהנים'). Fix those and re-export; the nonblocking items are optional polish.
